code:
auto.offset.reset=earliest   start from the beginning of history
auto.offset.reset=latest     skip to what's written from now on

Only matters with no prior committed offset to resume from.
caption: Backfill and analytics want earliest; live alerting wants latest.

code:
enable.auto.commit=true

consumer crashes AFTER commit, BEFORE handle() finishes
  --> that batch is marked processed, but never actually was
caption: Convenient, but can silently lose work at the wrong moment.

code:
records = consumer.poll(timeout=1.0)
for record in records:
    handle(record.key(), record.value())  # real work first
consumer.commit()                          # only then commit
caption: This pattern is exactly what at-least-once delivery looks like.

subtitle: How partitions get divided among a group's members.
